name: player_compute_surface_from3_probes
description: Player::ComputeSurfaceFrom3Probes fits the terrain support plane from three selected above-ground probes and resets terrain angular contact impulses.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player environment-probe surface-fit pass so point temporary layout, x87 dot-product ordering, and terrain reset caller context can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x42ca40 validates the airborne reset call, use of the first three g_PlayerEnvProbe_AboveGroundIndices, replacement of each point Y with candidateScoreBySample, ComputeTriangleNormal, SolveHeightOnSurface from point A and the new steerBasisRef, and final zeroing of angVelPitch and angVelRoll.
The native smoke verifies three-probe normal construction, solved player height, and final pitch/roll angular reset.
